coverage.summary: Residential units in San Francisco. The available documents state no building-size, construction-date, owner or landlord-size limits.

evidence.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco

result.notes: I set other_conditions to null. It described the prohibited devices, which is landlord conduct, not building, unit or owner coverage. I removed the Cartwright Act (Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729) reference from the summary because none of the provided documents mention it. DX06 is not among the provided documents, so it cannot be quoted. requires_unknown_facts is false because D081 applies the ban to residential units in San Francisco generally, not to a class of buildings that assessor data cannot identify. The ordinance text is not captured, so any exemptions or coverage limits in § 37.10C itself cannot be verified.
